title: test(hits-per-page): add common test suite
body:
This reworks the tests for the `hits-per-page` widget to move them in the common test suite, reduce flavor-specific tests, and remove unrealistic tests that manipulate internals.

[FX-2513](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-2513)
